# Wenzhou Sanhe Mold Co., Ltd.

> Precision-engineered injection, plastic, rubber, die-casting and automotive molds for global industries. Quality First. Pursue Excellence.

Sanhe Mold is a professional mold manufacturer based in Wenzhou, Zhejiang, China, serving clients across 30+ countries. Specializations include injection molds, plastic molds, rubber molds, die-casting molds, automotive molds, motorcycle molds, electrical appliance molds, and lock & commodity molds.
